title: Radiating Blue Ink Face
prompt: Hand-drawn 2D sketch in blue ballpoint pen on white unlined notebook paper with visible spiral binding holes on the left. A bald stylized human head floats centrally, rendered with continuous thin lines. The face has large wide-set oval eyes with dark pupils, simple arched eyebrows, a small nose with two nostril dots, and an open mouth showing upper teeth and a dark interior. Two small squiggle lines sit on top of the bald scalp. From the right side of the head, multiple parallel straight blue ink lines radiate outward like energy beams or sound waves. Minimalist, raw, sketchbook aesthetic, visible paper texture, no shading, flat lighting.
